scope: Finite source-only household persistence seam review

findings.title: Existing genuine keyed rows are rejected by placeholder descriptor value
findings.evidence: server/keyed.ts:373 always reports value undefined for existing keyed entries; get returns actual row separately
findings.reproducer: Normal collection with the report's valid lifeFacts row loaded through actual splitText and Layer; householdPoint on ordinary root wrapper returns invalid, including after pre-read
findings.repair: Use existing WeakMap-backed isKeyedMap for genuine map handling; ordinary objects use own enumerable data descriptor value without indexed access; retain own undefined refusal

findings.title: Node transaction root placeholder is rejected before point lookup
findings.evidence: server/store.ts:299 reports value undefined for existing DB own properties; Worker root descriptor returns actual value
findings.reproducer: Normal persisted root in a genuine Node store callback passed directly to householdPoint; rejected in legacy and entries layouts, even after pre-read
findings.repair: Explicit trusted transaction root extraction with presence and actual read, then strict unknown-root parser; no generic accessor/descriptor spoof relaxation

boundaryObligations.detail: Canonical metadata has twelve keys; Reflect.ownKeys enumerates all malformed root keys before rejection. Never enumerate child maps. Validate root once per transaction and define ingress root bounds.

lifeLocations and byCharacterLife are registered but lack validators. No consumer currently exists. Narrow supported validator map type or supply explicit strict lifecycle schemas and key/crosslink checks before writes.

Foundation shape guards read nested fields and can invoke accessors; use bounded descriptor snapshot before them or document trusted serialized precondition. Storage failures abort and must not become absence.
